kebab_example: aliyun agentloop create-experiment-plan --agent-space al-playground-cn-hongkong --plan-name rca_benchmark_eval_experiment --experiment-type OFFLINE --description example-string --dataset-id rca_benckmark_eval --evaluators '[{"variableMapping":{"output":"experiment_output","input":"experiment_input","expected_output":"dataset.ground_truth_json"},"evaluatorRef":"Builtin.agent_correctness","name":"Builtin.agent_correctness","filters":{"query":"example-string","sample":"100"},"type":"AGENT","resultType":"score","config":{"variables":[],"prompt":"example-string"},"resultName":"Builtin.agent_correctness"},{"variableMapping":{"output":"experiment_output","input":"experiment_input","question":"dataset.question","expected_output":"dataset.ground_truth_json","payload_json":"dataset.payload_json"},"evaluatorRef":"rca-toxicity-safety-accuracy","name":"rca-toxicity-safety-accuracy","filters":{"query":"example-string","sample":"100"},"type":"AGENT","resultType":"score","config":{"variables":[],"prompt":"example-string"},"resultName":"rca-toxicity-safety-accuracy"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateExperimentPlan

parameters.help_en: The experiment plan name. The name must be unique within the same AgentSpace and account
parameters.help_zh: 实验计划名称。同一 AgentSpace 下同一账号不可重名
parameters.name: plan_name

parameters.help_en: The experiment type. Set this parameter to `OFFLINE` or `ONLINE`
parameters.help_zh: 实验类型。请求传 `OFFLINE` 或 `ONLINE`
parameters.name: experiment_type

parameters.help_en: The description of the experiment plan
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated dataset. If this parameter is not specified, the execution phase processes in simple mode
parameters.help_zh: 关联的数据集 ID。不传时执行阶段按 simple 模式处理
parameters.name: dataset_id

fields.help_zh: 实验标签（A/B/C/D/E）
fields.name: label

fields.help_zh: 实验名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_zh: 模型名称（agent场景可填agent）
fields.name: model_name

fields.help_zh: 模型提供商：dashscope（默认）/ user / agent
fields.name: model_provider

fields.help_zh: 温度参数，控制输出随机性，范围0-2
fields.name: temperature

fields.help_zh: 最大输出Token数
fields.name: max_tokens

fields.help_zh: Top P 采样参数，范围0-1
fields.name: topp

fields.help_zh: Top K 采样参数，范围1-100
fields.name: topk

fields.help_zh: 频率惩罚，正值减少重复，范围-2.0到2.0
fields.name: frequency_penalty

fields.help_zh: 存在惩罚，正值鼓励新话题，范围-2.0到2.0
fields.name: presence_penalty

fields.help_zh: 停止序列，遇到时立即停止生成
fields.name: stop_sequences

fields.help_zh: The modelParameters
fields.name: model_parameters

fields.help_zh: 端点连接器ID（user/agent模式时必填）
fields.name: endpoint_connector_id

fields.help_zh: 角色：system/user/assistant
fields.name: role

fields.help_zh: 内容，支持{{变量名}}占位符
fields.name: content

fields.help_zh: Prompt消息模板，支持{{变量名}}占位符
fields.name: prompt_template

fields.help_zh: Agent请求体模板（agent模式时必填，支持{{变量名}}）
fields.name: request_body_template

fields.help_zh: Agent请求方法：POST（默认）/ GET
fields.name: request_method

parameters.example: [{"label": "A", "name": "experimentA", "modelName": "qwen3.7-plus", "modelProvider": "dashscope", "modelParameters": {"temperature": 0.7, "topP": 0.8, "presencePenalty": 0.0, "frequencyPenalty": 0.0}, "promptTemplate": [{"role": "system", "content": "你是阿里云 ARMS 产品答疑机器人"}, {"role": "user", "content": "{{input}}"}]}, {"label": "B", "name": "experimentB", "modelName": "qwen3.7-max", "modelProvider": "dashscope", "modelParameters": {"temperature": 0.7, "topP": 0.8, "presencePenalty": 0.0, "frequencyPenalty": 0.0}, "promptTemplate": [{"role": "system", "content": "你是阿里云 ARMS 产品答疑机器人"}, {"role": "user", "content": "{{input}}"}]}]
parameters.help_en: The list of experiment configurations. A maximum of 5 configurations are supported. For offline experiments, this parameter can be omitted or set to an empty array. For online experiments, at least one configuration is required
parameters.help_zh: 实验配置列表，最多 5 个。离线实验可不传或传空数组；在线实验至少传 1 个
parameters.name: experiments

fields.help_en: The reference name of a registered evaluator. When specified, the evaluator definition is loaded by this reference with higher priority. Both built-in evaluators and custom evaluators are supported
fields.help_zh: 已注册评估器的引用名称。传入后优先按该引用加载评估器定义，支持内置评估器和自定义评估器
fields.name: evaluator_ref

fields.help_en: The evaluator name. Required for inline evaluators when evaluatorRef is not specified. The evaluatorRef or name must be unique within the same task
fields.help_zh: 评估器名称。未传 evaluatorRef 的内联评估器场景必填；同一任务内 evaluatorRef 或 name 不能重复
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The evaluator type. Defaults to LLM if not specified. Inline CODE evaluators are currently not supported. For CODE type evaluators, reference a previously created evaluator by using evaluatorRef
fields.help_zh: 评估器类型。未传时默认 LLM；内联 CODE 评估器当前不支持，CODE 类型请通过 evaluatorRef 引用已创建评估器
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The field name for the evaluation result. Required for inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, the metricName defined in the evaluator definition is used if this parameter is not specified
fields.help_zh: 评估结果字段名。内联评估器场景必填；引用已有评估器时未传则使用评估器定义中的 metricName
fields.name: result_name

fields.help_en: The evaluation result type. Required for inline evaluators. Defaults to score when referencing an existing evaluator and this parameter is not specified
fields.help_zh: 评估结果类型。内联评估器场景必填；引用已有评估器时未传默认为 score
fields.name: result_type

fields.help_en: The evaluator runtime configuration. For inline LLM evaluators, this must include configurations such as prompt. When referencing an existing evaluator, this parameter is typically not required and is only specified when runtime parameters such as version need to be set
fields.help_zh: 评估器运行配置。内联 LLM 评估器需要包含 prompt 等配置；引用已有评估器时通常不传，仅在需要指定版本等运行时参数时传入
fields.name: config

fields.help_en: The evaluator-level data filter conditions. These take effect together with the task-level dataFilter.query
fields.help_zh: 评估器级数据筛选条件，会与任务级 dataFilter.query 共同生效
fields.name: filters

fields.help_en: The variable mapping that maps evaluator variables to evaluation data fields. Required for LLM/AGENT inline evaluators. When referencing an existing evaluator, the variable names must exist in the evaluator definition
fields.help_zh: 变量映射关系，将评估器变量映射到评估数据字段。LLM/AGENT 内联评估器必填，引用已有评估器时变量名必须存在于评估器定义中
fields.name: variable_mapping

parameters.help_en: The list of evaluators. After configuration, evaluation can be automatically triggered when the experiment completes
parameters.help_zh: 评估器列表。配置后实验完成时可自动触发评估
parameters.name: evaluators

parameters.help_en: The list of selected data item IDs in partial dataset mode. This parameter must be used together with `datasetId`
parameters.help_zh: 部分数据集模式下选定的数据项 ID 列表，需与 `datasetId` 配合使用
parameters.name: selected_item_ids

parameters.help_en: The custom query SQL clause in partial dataset mode. This parameter can be used when `selectedItemIds` is empty
parameters.help_zh: 部分数据集模式下的自定义查询 SQL 子句。`selectedItemIds` 为空时可使用
parameters.name: query_sql

parameters.help_zh: 关联的数据处理Pipeline名称（可选）。关联后，该计划下的实验执行完成写实验结果Logstore时，会按本次实验轨迹的traceId过滤并调用PreviewPipeline，将轨迹经Pipeline处理后的结果一并写入
parameters.name: pipeline_name

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. For offline experiments, experiments can be omitted. For online experiments, at least one experiment must be specified
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。离线实验可不传 experiments；在线实验至少传 1 个 experiments
v1_body_parameters.name: body

v1_parameters.help_en: The request body. For offline experiments, experiments can be omitted. For online experiments, at least one experiment must be specified
v1_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。离线实验可不传 experiments；在线实验至少传 1 个 experiments
v1_parameters.name: body
